apps.name: Equalizer APO
apps.description: System-wide equalizer for Windows; everything you play goes through it.
setup_steps: Install Equalizer APO and select your headphone output in its Configurator, then restart Windows.
Use “Apply to Equalizer APO” in this app, or copy the exported file into C:\Program Files\EqualizerAPO\config and add “Include: <file>” to config.txt.
For the convolution file: add “Convolution: <file>.wav” instead; it only works at the sample rate in its name.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: APO configuration reference — GraphicEQ, Channel: L/R, Include; Convolution files must match the device rate (no resampling).

apps.name: Peace
apps.description: Friendly interface for Equalizer APO on Windows.
setup_steps: Install Equalizer APO first, then Peace.
In Peace, select the Left speaker/channel, use Import and pick the file ending in “L ParametricEQ.txt”.
Select the Right speaker/channel and import the file ending in “R ParametricEQ.txt”, then Save.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: Peace wiki — up to 31 sliders (frequency/gain/Q) and per-speaker equalization confirmed; the Import menu's accepted formats are not documented — check by hand.

apps.name: EasyEffects
setup_steps: Add the Convolver effect to Output and import the exported .wav.
Tip: pin PipeWire to one rate (default.clock.rate) so the file's rate always matches.
Parametric: add the Equalizer effect and enable Split channels; with Left selected use Import APO preset and pick the “L ParametricEQ.txt” file, then do the same for Right with the “R” file.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: EasyEffects manual — Equalizer has 1–32 bands and Split channels. Importing one APO file with Channel: sections is unreliable (wwmm/easyeffects#1003), so the export is one file per ear. Convolver import not re-checked.

apps.name: CamillaDSP
apps.description: Flexible DSP engine for Windows, macOS and Linux, configured with a text file.
setup_steps: Copy the .wav files next to your CamillaDSP config.
Paste the snippet from the README into the config and reload.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: CamillaDSP README (v4.1) — Conv filter type Wav with channel, $samplerate$ token in filenames, pipeline Filter steps with a channels list.

apps.name: foobar2000
apps.description: Music player for Windows with a convolver component.
setup_steps: Install the Convolver component (foo_convolve). It only exists as a 32-bit component, so use the 32-bit (x86) foobar2000; the 64-bit version can't load it.
Add Convolver in Preferences > Playback > DSP Manager and load the file matching your music's sample rate (or add a Resampler before it and use one file).
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: foo_convolve 0.3.3 (2019) is Windows 32-bit only; no documented impulse resampling, so one file per rate. Not verified by hand.

apps.name: Roon
apps.description: Music player with built-in convolution on its DSP engine.
setup_steps: On a computer (Roon can't load filters from phones): Settings > Audio > your zone > DSP Engine > Convolution > Add.
Browse to the exported zip and upload it as is.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: Roon DSP Engine: Convolution — zip of impulse files + .cfg with relative paths; closest rate chosen, one file per rate recommended; upload from a computer (not mobile).

apps.name: eqMac
setup_steps: Needs eqMac Pro: its Expert equalizer has unlimited bands and separate Left/Right EQ (the free 10-band Advanced EQ can't hold this correction).
In the Expert equalizer, enable separate Left and Right, then enter each filter from the exported table for its ear.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: eqmac.app/features — Expert EQ (Pro): unlimited bands, gain/Q/frequency, filter types; Separate L/R EQ (Pro); Balance (free).

apps.name: SoundSource
apps.description: Per-app audio control and effects for macOS.
setup_steps: Add the built-in EQ effect to your output and enter each filter from the exported table.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: SoundSource's documentation doesn't say whether its built-in EQ accepts parametric filters; check by hand (or use an Audio Unit EQ in SoundSource).

apps.name: Wavelet
setup_steps: Save the file to your phone.
In Wavelet open Graphic equalizer > Import (AutoEq GraphicEQ) and pick the file.
Set Channel balance as noted.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: Wavelet imports AutoEq GraphicEQ files and has Channel balance (XDA); one EQ for both ears.

apps.name: RootlessJamesDSP
apps.description: System-wide DSP for Android without root, with a convolver.
setup_steps: Save the .wav to your phone.
Enable Convolver, choose the file as impulse response.
Note: apps that block audio capture (e.g. Spotify, Chrome) aren't processed by RootlessJamesDSP.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: README lists app limits (apps that block audio capture, e.g. Spotify/Chrome, stay unprocessed); convolver stereo/rate support not documented there — check by hand.

apps.name: Poweramp Equalizer
setup_steps: Save the file to your phone.
In Poweramp Equalizer use Presets > Import and pick the ParametricEQ file.
Set the balance as noted.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: Poweramp forum — AutoEq ParametricEQ files import; parametric bands have a per-band L/R pan, but an imported preset applies to both ears, so this stays shared-only.

apps.name: Neutron Music Player
apps.description: Audiophile music player for Android and iPhone with parametric EQ.
setup_steps: Open DSP Effects > Parametric EQ and enter each filter from the exported table.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: not documented online in enough detail (bands, per-channel EQ); check by hand.

apps.name: USB Audio Player PRO
apps.description: Android player for USB DACs, with parametric EQ.
setup_steps: Open the parametric EQ and enter each filter from the exported table.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: built-in parametric EQ by ToneBoosters (AutoEq wiki); band count and per-channel EQ not documented; check by hand.

apps.name: Qudelix 5K
apps.description: Bluetooth DAC/amp with built-in parametric EQ, set from its phone or desktop app.
setup_steps: In the Qudelix app open EQ > Custom PEQ, enable separate L/R if offered, and enter each filter.
apps.checked: 2026-10-27: 10-band PEQ (20 across two presets); L/R correction reported possible via its Speaker EQ, not documented officially — check by hand.

apps.name: Other / Advanced
apps.description: Any other EQ or convolver: choose formats, rates and files yourself.
setup_steps: Use the files with any app that accepts them; the README explains each file.
